scope: Read-only inference dependency and device audit; adapter authored separately. No package installation, download, checkpoint/model loading, GPU work, Word changes or rendering by this audit.

inference_chain.finding: Eval RGB ResizeShortestEdge(MIN_SIZE_TEST=640, MAX_SIZE_TEST=768, choice). Eval mapper size_divisibility=-1; no mapper padding.
Normalize original resized image separately for CLIP and DINO; ImageList pads both to model size_divisibility=32. CLIP input internally resized to 384x384.
Bilinear resize to 448x448, actual DINOv2 ViT-S/14 forward_features, reshape 32x32 patch features, bilinear guidance maps 96/48/24.
Drop CLIP class token and reshape remaining tokens to 24x24; call PartCATSegPredictor.
Use entire test text cache and mappings, including all ImageNet prompt templates, then actual Aggregator.
Full-vocabulary correlations and coupled class attention, then independent convolutional decoder. Four intermediate diagnostic costs are returned.

sem_seg_all is a separate sigmoid tensor before any object-class filtering, then CPU sem_seg_postprocess restores original image dimensions. sem_seg applies supplied object-class filtering and is discarded by image-only adapter.

core: actual local DINOv2 source and weights
dependencies.detectron2_role: Configuration, registries, metadata, build_model, checkpoint handling, ImageList/Instances, image transforms and sem_seg_postprocess. No ROI/NMS/deformable-convolution call is present in the selected PartCATSeg forward.
dependencies.compiled_import_boundary: Detectron2 package imports can still require an authentic _C extension even when no compiled operation participates in selected inference. A genuine CPU-compiled Detectron2 is a reasonable path; fake _C or model stubs are not acceptable.
dependencies.mmcv: Only actual mmcv import under baselines is offline data/datasets/mask_cls_collect.py track_parallel_progress. This preprocessing file is not imported by datasets/__init__.py and is not on selected inference chain.
dependencies.mmseg: No active mmseg call in selected inference; references in Swin source are comments.
dependencies.open_clip: Unconditional predictor import; ViT-B/16 model follows vendored OpenAI CLIP branch. Keep the genuine vendored open_clip package to satisfy imports, or use a clearly recorded lazy import, never a model stand-in.
dependencies.dinov2: Official external DINO source must be pinned separately. Adapter uses actual local torch.hub source, strict pretrained state loading, XFORMERS_DISABLED=1 and standard torch path; no network access.
dependencies.environment_conflict: requirements.txt pins torch1.12.1+cu113 while README installs torch2.2.2/cu121; README mmcv wheel index targets cu110/torch1.7.0. These are not a coherent binary lock. Record actual working environment; do not install every listed compiled package blindly.

cpu_findings.finding: self.device='cuda' ignores cfg.MODEL.DEVICE; port to explicit selected device.
Predictor independently chooses CUDA availability and ignores config. Text token/stack/background .cuda() at lines300/302/311/318 prevent CPU; device-only substitutions are required.
Four cached text tensors and metadata mapping tensors are ordinary attributes, not registered buffers; model.to(cpu) alone does not move them. Construct them directly on selected device.
Original torch.hub.load uses floating network source. Replace only asset transport with local pinned source and real weights; strict state loading preserves architecture.
Torch2.6+ changed weights_only default. Hash-bound official local full checkpoint requires explicitly recorded legacy loading semantics where needed.

cpu_feasibility: Selected network is composed of torch tensor operations with no inherent GPU-only mathematical operator found. Real CPU inference is plausible after the device-only portability changes, but has not been executed or timed by this audit. Modern torch/version-dependent behavior remains an execution check.
memory_findings: Use batch1 and outer torch.inference_mode; upstream no_grad starts only after CLIP and DINO encoders, so calling forward alone can retain encoder graphs.
Keep official 384/448 internal image sizes, 640/768 mapper resize, complete vocabulary, 80 ImageNet prompts, model layers and original numerical precision policy.
Aggregator ClassTransformerLayer attention mixes T classes (part_cat_seg_model.py:414-467). Running vocabulary subsets or independently chunking attention changes the model and is disallowed.

QueryAttention at part_cat_seg_model.py:337-365 uses unusual softmax(dim=1) and subsequent normalization(dim=2); replacing it with standard scaled_dot_product_attention is not mathematically equivalent.

Aggregator.conv_decoder at line739 folds B*T into convolution batch. Up/DoubleConv at lines567-606 use convolutions and per-sample GroupNorm, not BatchNorm. A batch1 slice of T in this decoder alone preserves operations per class, subject to device numerical parity validation.
Release diagnostic cost tensors and filtered sem_seg after each image; do not accumulate GPU results across a cohort.
The self.sequential=False field in PartCATSeg is unused and does not provide a ready low-memory path. AMP can change results and is not silently enabled by adapter.
evidence_boundaries: Official eval wrapper unconditionally reads obj_part_sem_seg and sem_seg but uses them only inside training. Fixed placeholder tensors satisfy interface; no part labels enter selected eval computation.

Official sem_seg is category-conditioned via instances.gt_classes[0]. Image-only adapter exports sem_seg_all only and should verify its invariance to alternative constant placeholder masks and object class.
Official evaluator masks predictions by ground-truth ignore support (partcatseg_evaluation.py:148); its masked predictions must never be used as raw image-only model output.
Background predictions retain last-channel ID (VOC116/PACO456) and must count as errors where ground truth is a valid part. Ignore65535 is only the PACO input placeholder and GT scoring sentinel.
PACO456 is a declared cross-dataset vocabulary adapter for the selected official VOC checkpoint, not a PACO-native checkpoint or a reproduced official PACO benchmark.

Predictor text/background caches are created before loading final segmentation checkpoint. Preserve official seeded order; do not silently regenerate caches from loaded non_object_embedding or fine-tuned CLIP weights.
A synthetic image validates execution, interface independence, decoder parity and resource use only; it provides no accuracy evidence.

adapter.implementation: Four hash-checked in-memory module overlays; six exact edit targets for device routing, local DINO entry, explicit torch.load semantics and Pillow LINEAR-to-BILINEAR alias. Original D source and frozen source copy unchanged. Full source manifest integrity and raw checkpoint/model key/shape sets are audited; any mismatch fails before accepting inference.
adapter.static_validation: AST parse and exact SHA/replacement-count checks passed for all four modules; stdlib-only inspection, no torch/model import.
adapter.decoder_validation: VOC original versus chunked outputs must satisfy allclose rtol1e-5/atol1e-6 and identical argmax. Receipt binds adapter/source hashes, model, torch/CUDA/cuDNN/flags/device and chunk size. Cohort also requires completed dummy-target invariance PASS. Runtime validation NOT RUN by this audit.
adapter.dummy_validation: Implemented optional repeat inference with alternative constant dummy masks/class, allclose and identical argmax; no annotation read.
adapter.cohort_mode: Implemented --cohort-manifest for one model construction and 42 anonymous image-only forwards. Hash-bound frozen protocol, input manifest, registry, adapter, checkpoint, source and decoder receipt. Per-case failures retained; final predictions_manifest.json sealed and receipt.json binds its hash. No scorer or GT import/read.
